Title: Alpaca Market Data plans
Supported point: Individual Basic lists IEX-only stocks, 30 stock streams, 200 historical requests/minute, indicative options. Individual and business arrangements differ.
Limitation: Provider/runtime/rights testing still required.

Title: Alpaca feed semantics
Supported point: Historical feed selection is explicit; free SIP history requires end at least 15 minutes old. Subscription-default feed selection can change.
Limitation: No assumption of consolidated live quotes in the free mode.

Title: Alpaca paper environment
Supported point: Paper simulation omits important real execution effects. Paper-only access is a candidate for free onboarding.
Limitation: Our simulator must declare its own economics; paper results are not proof of real performance.

Title: SnapTrade broker access
Supported point: Broker guide lists supported integration routes, with production access requirements.
Limitation: Test each broker, account type, auth method, deployment and field; names on a list are not acceptance evidence.

Title: SnapTrade trade detection
Supported point: Wealthsimple and Questrade trade detection is documented at five-minute-or-longer intervals.
Limitation: Account-state freshness must be separate from quote and processing latency.

Title: Questrade API
Supported point: Personal users can access account/market information; API trade execution is limited to partner developers.
Limitation: Read-only capabilities only; company integration permission is a separate gate.

Title: IBKR Web API
Supported point: Read-only portfolio subset exists. Third-party vendor integration requires approval and a distinct authentication process.
Limitation: No unattended commercial or local auth route assumed from a personal login.

Title: Wealthsimple activity export
Supported point: Activity CSV download is documented.
Limitation: Real anonymized samples and corporate-action reconciliation are not yet tested.

Title: Yahoo portfolio CSV

Title: SEC EDGAR APIs
Supported point: SEC provides submissions and XBRL APIs.
Limitation: Respect fair-access rules; publication dates, units and restatements require normalization. No analyst-consensus promise.

Title: Bank of Canada Valet
Supported point: Valet has no usage charge, registration or access-key requirement; daily data can be cached.
Limitation: Reference FX, not an executable conversion quote; respect terms and data timing.

Title: ChatGPT plan in other apps
Supported point: Plan-funded requests are available in participating apps/tools subject to eligibility and plan rules.
Limitation: App participation, deployment and permissible financial use must be qualified; no universal subscription API.

Title: Claude Code authentication rules
Supported point: Native unmodified Claude Code authentication is distinguished from prohibited collection/intermediation of Claude.ai credentials by third parties.
Limitation: Use API keys or approved native flow; no session-token proxy. Hosted feasibility remains open.

Title: xAI API authentication
Supported point: API keys authenticate inference requests as bearer credentials.
Limitation: API adapter required; consumer-subscription access is not promised.

Title: PostgreSQL row security
Supported point: Superusers, BYPASSRLS roles and ordinarily table owners can bypass row security.
Limitation: Use nonowner/nonbypass service roles and explicit isolation tests; RLS alone is insufficient.

Title: gVisor overview
Supported point: gVisor provides an application-kernel isolation approach integrated with container execution.
Limitation: Chosen Linux sandbox qualification target, not proof of sufficient security or universal host compatibility.

Title: BCSC securities fundamentals
Supported point: Being in the business of advising about securities can engage registration requirements, subject to applicable exemptions.
Limitation: Counsel must classify this actual non-discretionary product per jurisdiction. A disclaimer is not clearance.

Title: SEC investor bulletin on robo-advisers
Supported point: Automated investment advice has securities-law considerations, including SEC/state adviser frameworks.
Limitation: Not a product-specific determination; map federal and relevant state obligations with counsel.

Title: FINRA stop-order risks
Supported point: A stop trigger does not guarantee the execution price, and stop-limit orders may not execute.
Limitation: Planned stop loss is a scenario, not guaranteed maximum loss.

Title: OIC assignment
Supported point: American-style short options can be assigned before expiry.
Limitation: Separate expiration payoff from pathwise collateral, assignment and settlement risk.

Title: OIC vertical put spreads
Supported point: Vertical-spread analysis includes early-assignment and financing consequences, not merely an expiry payoff.
Limitation: Do not model a spread as an inseparable atomic position throughout its life.

Title: Probability of Backtest Overfitting
Supported point: Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu discuss selection-related backtest overfitting and a diagnostic framework.
Limitation: Diagnostics inform research; no universal test proves a trading edge.
